def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    if n > m:
        n, m = m, n
    if n == 1:
        r = m % 6
        ans = m - [0, 1, 2, 3, 2, 1][r]
    elif n == 2:
        if m == 2:
            ans = 0
        elif m == 3:
            ans = 4
        elif m == 7:
            ans = 12
        else:
            ans = m * 2
    else:
        if (n & 1) == 1 and (m & 1) == 1:
            ans = n * m - 1
        else:
            ans = n * m
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
